_comment: The call did not reach the patient. no_answer is one of the statuses recognised as a genuine non-contact, and it is the only class of outcome that earns another dial: two retries at different times of day, then the patient is handed to staff. An unrecognised or non-terminal status is held instead of retried.
_matching: Replace REPLACE_WITH_call_id_FROM_SHEET with the value in the row's call_id column after placing a dry-run call. A result that cannot be matched to the call in flight is held for review rather than applied.
